Web targets currently open a fixed URL and reject arguments.
acceptance_criteria: Define and validate metadata for supported web-tool deep links, including how terms are processed and safely URL-encoded. Accept terms through a documented CLI interface and use the same resulting URL for browser launch and --print-url. Preserve the existing base URL behavior when no terms are supplied, and give clear feedback when a tool does not support supplied terms. Add focused tests and usage documentation, with at least one supported web-tool example.
